[{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"ABOUT THE MAJOR","groupId":"98df7145-6887-ef11-8474-000d3a37e3b6","position":0,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

The primary focus of the Mathematics Single Subject (Mathematics for Teachers) major is to equip students with the mathematical knowledge required to teach in seventh grade through high school. The Math Single Subject (Math for Teachers) major is for students desiring a single-subject California Teaching Credential in Math. For a description of the Secondary Education/California Preliminary Single Subject Teaching Credential, see School of Education section of this catalog.
